5af771b4e1f5.fonte: The transition is validated by the domain's state machine, not by the client: created → active → closing → closed | closed_abnormally. An invalid jump is 409.
5af771b4e1f5.traducao: 状态转换由领域的状态机校验，而不是由客户端：created → active → closing → closed | closed_abnormally。无效的跳转返回 409。

c2576b1270c1.fonte: Returns 201, not 200, because the handler is `@Post` without `@HttpCode` — that's Nest's default. Documented as-is instead of changed: the semantics are debatable, the behavior isn't defective, and the table test fails on any divergence between the two.
c2576b1270c1.traducao: 返回 201 而不是 200，因为处理器是 `@Post` 且没有 `@HttpCode`——这是 Nest 的默认行为。按现状记录而不是修改：语义值得商榷，行为本身并无缺陷，而表格测试会在两者之间出现任何差异时失败。

3d40a3c5b36b.fonte: Transition not allowed from the current state.
3d40a3c5b36b.traducao: 不允许从当前状态进行此转换。

6cfee32d99f7.fonte: Moves the session to another state
6cfee32d99f7.traducao: 将会话移动到另一个状态

171ef5ae365e.fonte: The MEMBER's audience. Only the caller's own rows — the actor comes from the authenticated token and there is no parameter to swap it. In tokens and ESTIMATED cost, without breaking down by provider or by credential: the key that ran is the owner's (RN-058) and its invoice is theirs (RN-060). The provider axis came to exist in the owner's report (ADR 0076) and remains unreachable from here — there is no dimension parameter on this route, and the repository type refuses the combination (RN-187). Agent doesn't count: `token_usage` records who spent, not who ordered the spend.
171ef5ae365e.traducao: 面向成员的视图。只有调用方自己的记录——参与者来自已认证的令牌，没有可替换它的参数。以 token 和估算成本呈现，不按提供商或凭据细分：运行的密钥属于所有者（RN-058），其账单也属于所有者（RN-060）。提供商维度在所有者的报告中才存在（ADR 0076），从这里仍不可达——此路由没有维度参数，仓储类型也拒绝这种组合（RN-187）。代理不计入：`token_usage` 记录的是谁花费了，而不是谁下令花费。

3568acb68ff3.fonte: My own consumption in this project, by session and by day
3568acb68ff3.traducao: 我自己在此项目中的消耗，按会话和按天

9262cbe64aff.fonte: The story leaves the backlog, the coverage, the promotion queue, the Dev Lead's plan and the claim — and so do its tasks. Nothing is deleted: the row stays with `archivedAt`, and `backlog.story_archived` records who, why and which tasks. Only a `draft` story with no task in execution.
9262cbe64aff.traducao: 该 story 离开 backlog、覆盖、提升队列、Dev Lead 的计划和认领——其任务也一样。不会删除任何内容：记录保留并带有 `archivedAt`，`backlog.story_archived` 记录由谁、为何以及哪些任务。仅限没有执行中任务的 `draft` story。

52fad7b40260.fonte: The story leaves the proposal queue and the reason becomes a message pinned to the PO's session — the same pattern as returning a gate to dev. If that session's PO is no longer up, the return is recorded anyway: it's the user's decision and does not depend on an agent listening.
52fad7b40260.traducao: 该 story 离开提议队列，理由会变成固定在 PO 会话中的一条消息——与把 gate 退回给 dev 的模式相同。如果该会话的 PO 已不在运行，退回仍会被记录：这是用户的决定，不依赖于有代理在听。

971ed6695adf.fonte: Returns a refused story to the PO, with the reason
971ed6695adf.traducao: 将被拒绝的 story 退回给 PO，并附上理由

af4584adb98d.fonte: Only a `draft` story with no task in execution (`in_progress`/`in_review`). Writes `backlog.story_updated` with the previous and the new title. Same role as the other backlog writes (promote/return).
af4584adb98d.traducao: 仅限 `draft` story，且没有执行中的任务（`in_progress`/`in_review`）。写入 `backlog.story_updated`，附带旧标题和新标题。所需角色与其他 backlog 写入操作（提升/退回）相同。

ae34e3e00950.traducao: 标题为空或超过 200 个字符。

07cc58f9f20b.fonte: Corrects the title of a draft story (RN-727)
07cc58f9f20b.traducao: 修正草稿 story 的标题（RN-727）

dbe4c52f44b6.fonte: The human step that `manual` mode (default since Phase 12c) hands back to the user: until promotion, NO task from the story is pickable by any dev agent. Promoting releases the batch of tasks at once and wakes up the idle agents of the module (Phase 12b). The batch is NOT all-or-nothing — whatever didn't pass comes back as `failed` with the reason, and whatever passed is promoted.
dbe4c52f44b6.traducao: `manual` 模式（自 Phase 12c 起为默认）交还给用户的人工步骤：在提升之前，该 story 的任何任务都不能被任何 dev agent 认领。提升会一次性放出这批任务，并唤醒该模块中空闲的代理（Phase 12b）。这一批不是全有或全无——未通过的会以 `failed` 返回并附上原因，通过的则被提升。

cabcb1b532d0.fonte: Promotes stories the PO proposed to `ready`
cabcb1b532d0.traducao: 将 PO 提议的 story 提升为 `ready`

cabfc04a294c.fonte: A gate cycle stalled for more than 2 h is parked instead of restarted on its own (ADR 0207). This is the human gesture that resumes it.
cabfc04a294c.traducao: 停滞超过 2 小时的 gate 周期会被暂停，而不是自行重启（ADR 0207）。这是恢复它的人工操作。

61937e759b84.fonte: The cycle is not parked — body with `reason: "gate_nao_estacionado"`.
61937e759b84.traducao: 该周期未被暂停——响应体带有 `reason: "gate_nao_estacionado"`。

76b0f9582dd0.traducao: 恢复一个被暂停的 gate 周期

b6056c3f57f7.fonte: Mesmo socket `/runner`, mesmo tópico, papel "terminal" — quem VÊ o terminal (o comando em si só roda de verdade se houver um runner conectado). Vale para qualquer modo de projeto.
b6056c3f57f7.traducao: 同一个 `/runner` 套接字、同一个主题，角色为 “terminal”——即查看终端的一方（命令本身只有在有 runner 连接时才会真正运行）。适用于任何项目模式。

0abdf9f25224.fonte: Emite um ticket de uso único para a aba Terminal da web
0abdf9f25224.traducao: 为 Web 的 Terminal 标签页签发一次性票据

bdf87f4330ef.fonte: Proxy de GitHub Releases — `platform` aceita só linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64. Sem autenticação: o binário não é segredo. Os bytes são conferidos contra o `checksums.txt` da mesma Release antes de qualquer coisa ser respondida (ADR 0149, RN-525); a rota NÃO verifica a assinatura do manifesto — isso é integridade, não procedência, e quem verifica assinatura é o `install.sh`.
bdf87f4330ef.traducao: GitHub Releases 代理——`platform` 只接受 linux-x64、linux-arm64、darwin-arm64。无需认证：二进制文件不是机密。在返回任何内容之前，字节会与同一 Release 的 `checksums.txt` 核对（ADR 0149，RN-525）；该路由不验证清单的签名——这是完整性而非来源，验证签名的是 `install.sh`。

f64ea695edce.fonte: O binário do runner, em stream, com o sha256 já conferido contra o manifesto. Não é JSON: `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`. O header `Content-Digest` repete o hash conferido (RFC 9530).
f64ea695edce.traducao: 以流方式返回 runner 二进制文件，其 sha256 已与清单核对。不是 JSON：`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。`Content-Digest` 头重复已核对的哈希（RFC 9530）。

f84e59b2b309.fonte: Recusa nomeada — nunca bytes com aviso. O corpo traz `motivo`: `plataforma_nao_publicada`, `release_sem_manifesto`, `manifesto_nao_cobre_a_plataforma`, `manifesto_ilegivel`, `download_falhou` ou `hash_divergente`.
f84e59b2b309.traducao: 具名拒绝——绝不返回带警告的字节。响应体带有 `motivo`：`plataforma_nao_publicada`、`release_sem_manifesto`、`manifesto_nao_cobre_a_plataforma`、`manifesto_ilegivel`、`download_falhou` 或 `hash_divergente`。

f15904bddcc7.fonte: Baixa o binário standalone do runner local pra plataforma pedida
f15904bddcc7.traducao: 为所请求的平台下载本地 runner 的独立二进制文件

f93fb9749cd2.fonte: Autenticada por uma chave de dispositivo de MÁQUINA (ADR 0154) — NUNCA por JWT de sessão, e nunca por uma credencial presa a um projeto, que responde 403. Devolve os projetos em `execution_mode: "runner"` nos quais o dono da chave alcança pelo menos `developer` (o mesmo mínimo de `POST .../runner-ticket`), com o nome da pasta e o estado de verificação de cada um. O agente pergunta em vez de varrer o disco: a base da máquina é do usuário e pode ter pasta que não é projeto nenhum.
f93fb9749cd2.traducao: 通过机器设备密钥认证（ADR 0154）——绝不通过会话 JWT，也绝不通过绑定到项目的凭据，后者返回 403。返回处于 `execution_mode: "runner"` 的项目，其中密钥所有者至少拥有 `developer`（与 `POST .../runner-ticket` 的最低要求相同），并附带每个项目的文件夹名称和验证状态。代理会询问而不是扫描磁盘：机器的基目录属于用户，其中可能有并非任何项目的文件夹。

169d7b6fea8b.fonte: A credencial apresentada está presa a um projeto — esta rota exige uma chave de dispositivo de máquina.
169d7b6fea8b.traducao: 所出示的凭据绑定到某个项目——此路由需要机器设备密钥。

a467111d8084.fonte: Lista os projetos em modo "runner" que este agente local atende
a467111d8084.traducao: 列出此本地代理所服务的 “runner” 模式项目

c11293a41969.fonte: No role required: a credential is about whoever called, not about a workspace or project. Covers LLM keys and git tokens in the same listing.
c11293a41969.traducao: 无需角色：凭据关乎调用者本人，而不是某个 workspace 或项目。在同一列表中涵盖 LLM 密钥和 git 令牌。

fedc948e26fc.fonte: Lists the current user's own credentials
fedc948e26fc.traducao: 列出当前用户自己的凭据

ff087e82419b.fonte: Upsert by (user, provider). The key is encrypted via envelope encryption before touching the database, and the response carries only the PROJECTION — never the secret, not even encrypted.
ff087e82419b.traducao: 按（用户，提供商）upsert。密钥在接触数据库之前通过信封加密进行加密，响应只携带投影——绝不包含机密，即使是加密后的也不包含。

bf9aed3d99e4.fonte: Registers or replaces a provider's API key
bf9aed3d99e4.traducao: 登记或替换某个提供商的 API 密钥

58bf8c9a0d17.fonte: Idempotent: deleting what does not exist also responds `{ ok: true }`.
58bf8c9a0d17.traducao: 幂等：删除不存在的内容也返回 `{ ok: true }`。

cfbecffddf77.traducao: 移除某个提供商的凭据

5ed98e17dc1a.fonte: The check is an explicit action, separate from registration (ADR 0050): the api decrypts the secret, calls the provider, and returns ONLY the verdict — the key never comes back, not even in part. Responds 200 for all three outcomes, because the request was processed; `refused` is an outcome, not a protocol error. 404 when there is no credential for (user, provider) — then there is nothing to test.
5ed98e17dc1a.traducao: 检查是一个显式操作，与登记分开（ADR 0050）：api 解密机密、调用提供商，只返回裁决——密钥绝不会返回，哪怕是一部分。三种结果都返回 200，因为请求已被处理；`refused` 是一种结果，不是协议错误。当（用户，提供商）没有凭据时返回 404——那时没有可测试的东西。

8e6cfeb845e3.fonte: Checks the ALREADY stored credential against the provider
8e6cfeb845e3.traducao: 用提供商检查已存储的凭据

d09466b0548c.fonte: Its own path, not the `users/me/credentials` one, because the body is different (`token`, and the provider enum is `github`/`gitlab`). The token is encrypted and stored without prior verification (ADR 0050); to verify it, `POST /users/me/credentials/{provider}/test`. Reading, removal, and testing reuse the `users/me/credentials` routes — it's the same table.
d09466b0548c.traducao: 使用自己的路径，而不是 `users/me/credentials`，因为请求体不同（`token`，且提供商枚举为 `github`/`gitlab`）。令牌经过加密并在未事先验证的情况下存储（ADR 0050）；如需验证，请调用 `POST /users/me/credentials/{provider}/test`。读取、移除和测试复用 `users/me/credentials` 路由——它们是同一张表。

1fa671c2e5dc.fonte: Registers a git token (encrypted, without testing)
1fa671c2e5dc.traducao: 登记一个 git 令牌（加密，不测试）

d1f7bc0cef1d.fonte: Account-level, with no project in the path (RN-611): the one-line install creates a machine key before any project exists, and every other listing is per project. Returns ONLY machine keys (`especie: "maquina"`, `projectId: null`) and ONLY the caller’s — project keys stay in their project’s listing, and no one sees another user’s keys (RN-519). Revoked keys are INCLUDED: registering a new machine key revokes the previous one (RN-552), and this list is where that shows. `lastUsedAt` is a recorded use, never a live connection; null means the key was never used.
d1f7bc0cef1d.traducao: 账户级别，路径中没有项目（RN-611）：一行命令安装会在任何项目存在之前创建机器密钥，而其他所有列表都是按项目的。只返回机器密钥（`especie: "maquina"`，`projectId: null`），且只返回调用方的——项目密钥保留在其项目的列表中，任何人都看不到其他用户的密钥（RN-519）。已撤销的密钥也包含在内：登记新的机器密钥会撤销上一把（RN-552），而这个列表就是体现这一点的地方。`lastUsedAt` 是一次记录的使用，绝不是活动连接；为空表示该密钥从未被使用。

d61be42a9613.fonte: Lists the authenticated user's own MACHINE device keys
d61be42a9613.traducao: 列出已认证用户自己的机器设备密钥

c596d6934895.fonte: Idempotent — revoking again is not an error. Same revocation as `DELETE /projects/{projectId}/runner-device-keys/{deviceKeyId}`: it also drops the LIVE connections opened with this key, in EVERY project (RN-520/RN-543). Since RN-685 (ADR 0201) the target is the KEY: another runner of the same user, connected with a PAT or with another key, stays up. The key’s still-unused tickets are voided. With no project yet there is no connection to drop. A PROJECT key, a key that does not exist and another user’s key all answer the same 404.
c596d6934895.traducao: 幂等——再次撤销不是错误。与 `DELETE /projects/{projectId}/runner-device-keys/{deviceKeyId}` 是同一种撤销：它还会断开用此密钥打开的活动连接，遍及所有项目（RN-520/RN-543）。自 RN-685（ADR 0201）起，目标是密钥本身：同一用户用 PAT 或其他密钥连接的另一个 runner 不受影响。该密钥尚未使用的票据会被作废。还没有项目时，就没有可断开的连接。项目密钥、不存在的密钥和其他用户的密钥都返回同样的 404。

51b1cb18b7bd.fonte: No machine key with this id belongs to the caller (it does not exist, is a project key, or is someone else’s — one answer for all).
51b1cb18b7bd.traducao: 没有属于调用方且具有此 id 的机器密钥（它不存在、是项目密钥，或属于别人——一种回答涵盖所有情况）。

63c062169084.fonte: Revokes one of the authenticated user’s own MACHINE device keys
63c062169084.traducao: 撤销已认证用户自己的一把机器设备密钥

4e0285e38905.fonte: Reads the authenticated user's interface language and agent response language
4e0285e38905.traducao: 读取已认证用户的界面语言和代理回复语言

e7f08f7413f7.fonte: Both fields are optional and independent — sending one never touches the other, and a body with neither is a 400. `locale` (the interface) stays closed to the `pt-BR`/`en` list. `responseLanguage` (RN-618) is `automatico` or any recognized BCP-47 code, stored canonical; an unrecognized code is a 400 and nothing in the body is written.
e7f08f7413f7.traducao: 两个字段都是可选且相互独立的——发送其中一个绝不会影响另一个，两者都没有的请求体返回 400。`locale`（界面）仍限定在 `pt-BR`/`en` 列表中。`responseLanguage`（RN-618）为 `automatico` 或任何可识别的 BCP-47 代码，以规范形式存储；无法识别的代码返回 400，请求体中的任何内容都不会被写入。

978e42a82cb1.fonte: Writes the authenticated user's interface language and/or agent response language
978e42a82cb1.traducao: 写入已认证用户的界面语言和/或代理回复语言

d0765926a5fc.fonte: The only way a detected language becomes a preference (RN-624): detection alone never changes anything. `confirm` writes `detectedLanguage` + `detectedLanguageConfirmedAt`; `decline` records the refusal so the same language is not asked again. Returns the preferences after the answer.
d0765926a5fc.traducao: 检测到的语言成为偏好的唯一途径（RN-624）：仅凭检测绝不会改变任何东西。`confirm` 写入 `detectedLanguage` + `detectedLanguageConfirmedAt`；`decline` 记录拒绝，以免再次询问同一种语言。返回回答之后的偏好设置。

d6b3175c9a03.fonte: A code that is not a recognized BCP-47 language.
d6b3175c9a03.traducao: 不是可识别的 BCP-47 语言代码。

b22bd7b3e0f1.fonte: `deteccao_mudou`: on `confirm`, your recent messages no longer point to that language — nothing was written.
b22bd7b3e0f1.traducao: `deteccao_mudou`：在 `confirm` 时，你最近的消息已不再指向该语言——未写入任何内容。

728a9eaf4308.traducao: 回答关于检测到的语言的问题

b27e4b7607bc.fonte: Already filtered by association — there is no global listing. Each item carries the caller's own role.
b27e4b7607bc.traducao: 已按关联关系过滤——没有全局列表。每个条目都携带调用方自己的角色。

58e2d9d2ef8b.traducao: 在 workspace 中的角色不足。

0ca72d5b71cf.fonte: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.
0ca72d5b71cf.traducao: workspace 不存在或对调用方不可见。

8f65698eab56.fonte: Requires no role: whoever creates it becomes `owner`. It's the only entry point for someone who doesn't belong to any workspace yet.
8f65698eab56.traducao: 不需要任何角色：创建者成为 `owner`。这是尚不属于任何 workspace 的人的唯一入口。

bce3555e8456.fonte: A workspace with this slug already exists.
bce3555e8456.traducao: 已存在使用此 slug 的 workspace。

58c610901a1c.fonte: Changes the workspace's name or slug
58c610901a1c.traducao: 修改 workspace 的名称或 slug

dc5c18e9e7a3.fonte: Requires `owner`. Takes its projects, sessions, and their history along with it.
dc5c18e9e7a3.traducao: 需要 `owner`。会连同其项目、会话及其历史一起删除。

e6a60f4f0cc5.fonte: One row per project of the workspace — since RN-521 a project that never provisioned a container is PRESENT with `registrado: null` instead of absent, because this page is the human path to start the first one. The observed state is asked of the broker only for rows `provisioning`/`running`, and only up to a per-load budget — see `naoVerificado` on rows that were skipped, and ADR 0136 for the reasoning.
e6a60f4f0cc5.traducao: workspace 的每个项目一行——自 RN-521 起，从未置备过容器的项目会以 `registrado: null` 出现，而不是缺席，因为这个页面是人工启动第一个容器的途径。只对 `provisioning`/`running` 的行向 broker 查询观测状态，且仅在每次加载的预算之内——被跳过的行见 `naoVerificado`，原因见 ADR 0136。

5243afc8c00e.fonte: Lists every project in the workspace and its container, if any
5243afc8c00e.traducao: 列出 workspace 中的每个项目及其容器（如有）

5c8813284399.fonte: Exists because the key agents spend is the workspace OWNER's (RN-058) — whoever pays the bill needs to see the bill. Groups by provider because that is the unit of the credential, and separates what went out by AGENT from what went out by a person in chat: the two come out of the same key and answer different questions. Returns no secret at all.
5c8813284399.traducao: 之所以存在，是因为代理花费的密钥属于 workspace 所有者（RN-058）——付账的人需要看到账单。按提供商分组，因为那是凭据的单位，并把代理花出去的与人在聊天中花出去的分开：两者出自同一把密钥，回答的是不同的问题。不返回任何机密。

29d69c2d518a.traducao: 需要在 workspace 上拥有 `owner`。

ac93370cf8a5.fonte: How much the owner's keys spent, by provider and by month

114550f4f81c.fonte:
Only `owner`, like the upsert. Removes the workspace row AND, in the same transaction, the user's rows in every project of this workspace (the project role overrides the workspace one, so leaving them would keep the user inside those projects), plus the user's PROJECT device keys and personal access tokens in them. Afterwards the live runner connection of that user in each project is dropped, best effort. Machine device keys and open sessions are left alone — they stop reaching this workspace because the role resolves to none.

Removing YOURSELF is refused with 403 and cannot be enabled anywhere: there is no level above to catch the fall. That same clause is what protects the last `owner` — only an `owner` can call this route and nobody removes themselves, so every successful call leaves at least the caller as `owner`. Removing ANOTHER `owner` is allowed — it is how ownership is revoked — except the OWNER OF RECORD (`createdBy`), refused with 409 `criador_do_workspace` until `PUT :workspaceId/owner-of-record` moves it to another owner: the LLM key agents spend and the spend report are theirs. Idempotent: a target without a workspace row still has this workspace's project rows cleared, and gets `204`.
114550f4f81c.traducao:
只有 `owner` 可以调用，与 upsert 相同。移除 workspace 记录，并在同一事务中移除该用户在此 workspace 每个项目中的记录（项目角色覆盖 workspace 角色，保留它们会让该用户留在那些项目中），以及该用户在这些项目中的项目设备密钥和个人访问令牌。之后会尽力断开该用户在每个项目中的活动 runner 连接。机器设备密钥和已打开的会话不受影响——由于角色解析为无，它们不再能触及此 workspace。

移除你自己会以 403 拒绝，且在任何地方都无法启用：上面没有更高层级来兜底。正是这一条款保护了最后一个 `owner`——只有 `owner` 可以调用此路由且没有人能移除自己，因此每次成功调用后至少还有调用方是 `owner`。移除另一个 `owner` 是允许的——这是撤销所有权的方式——但记录所有者（`createdBy`）除外，它会以 409 `criador_do_workspace` 拒绝，直到 `PUT :workspaceId/owner-of-record` 把它转给另一个所有者：代理花费的 LLM 密钥和花费报告都是他们的。幂等：没有 workspace 记录的目标仍会清除其在此 workspace 中的项目记录，并返回 `204`。

7b77f642a9c7.fonte:
The folder picker for Mounted mode, served by the api instead of by the runner (RN-504). Scoped HARD to `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE` (ADR 0141): `path` is optional and defaults to the base itself, and any `path` outside it is a `400` — a malformed request, not a permission problem, since no role browses outside the base.

Capped on purpose: directories only, at most 500 of them (sorted BEFORE the cut, with `truncado` saying so), never recursive, dot-prefixed entries excluded, and symlinks reported but never followed. What is left out is COUNTED (`arquivos`, `simbolicos`) so a folder full of code never looks empty.

There is no POST companion: creating a folder belongs to materializing the mounted workspace, never to the picker.
7b77f642a9c7.traducao:
Mounted 模式的文件夹选择器，由 api 而不是 runner 提供（RN-504）。严格限定在 `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE` 内（ADR 0141）：`path` 是可选的，默认为基目录本身，任何在其之外的 `path` 都返回 `400`——这是格式错误的请求，而不是权限问题，因为没有任何角色能浏览基目录之外的内容。

刻意设限：只列目录，最多 500 个（在截断之前排序，并用 `truncado` 说明），绝不递归，排除以点开头的条目，符号链接只报告而绝不跟随。被略去的内容会被计数（`arquivos`、`simbolicos`），这样满是代码的文件夹绝不会看起来是空的。

没有配套的 POST：创建文件夹属于物化挂载 workspace 的过程，绝不属于选择器。

The single folder on the operator machine that the api and engine containers can see, mounted by identity (ADR 0141). `null` — a normal state, never an error — means this installation has no `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE`, so the project wizard must not offer Mounted mode at all. The same value for every workspace: it is installation configuration, and `workspaceId` only scopes the authorization.

`brokerConfigurado` answers the other half of the same question: `container` and `mounted` only start a container through the broker (ADR 0144), so without it the wizard does not pre-select Mounted and offers Runner instead (ADR 0161, RN-573).

运营者机器上 api 和 engine 容器都能看到的那个唯一文件夹，按身份挂载（ADR 0141）。`null`——一种正常状态，绝不是错误——表示此安装没有 `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE`，因此项目向导完全不能提供 Mounted 模式。每个 workspace 的值都相同：它是安装配置，`workspaceId` 只用于限定授权范围。

`brokerConfigurado` 回答同一问题的另一半：`container` 和 `mounted` 只通过 broker 启动容器（ADR 0144），因此没有它时向导不会预选 Mounted，而是提供 Runner（ADR 0161，RN-573）。

Sliding window in days, and the daily series comes DENSE — a day with no spend comes in as zero, otherwise the sparkline lies about the pace.

7324cea83b26.fonte: On by default. When on AND the turn model is from OpenRouter, an agent step with two or more tools first asks the Jev which tool fits, and the chat model is offered only that tool and the previous one. The Jev never approves or denies anything: an action that needs approval still does. Any failure of the Jev falls back to the whole catalog. Turning it off stops every call to the Jev, and its cost with them.
7324cea83b26.traducao: 默认开启。开启且回合模型来自 OpenRouter 时，拥有两个或更多工具的代理步骤会先询问 Jev 哪个工具合适，聊天模型只会被提供该工具和上一个工具。Jev 从不批准或拒绝任何东西：需要批准的操作仍然需要批准。Jev 的任何失败都会回落到整个目录。关闭它会停止对 Jev 的所有调用，其成本也随之停止。

3362f14aeb7e.fonte:
The bell's drawer, for the whole workspace (RN-091). Each cursor says up to which `seq` that project has already been read, and the response carries what came after that in each one's most recent session.

**It's POST because it's the only verb with a BODY, not because it changes state.** The server doesn't know where each reader stopped: "read up to here" is a `seq` per project stored in the browser, and there is (deliberately) no mark-as-read endpoint. So the cutoff needs to TRAVEL in the request, and there are dozens of pairs — in a query string that becomes a long URL, which a proxy truncates, and would also put the user's project ids in access logs. The route is idempotent and has no side effect: it responds `200`, never `201`.

Replaces one request PER PROJECT with the drawer open — 23 projects cost 286 req/min against a limit of 300.
3362f14aeb7e.traducao:
铃铛的抽屉，面向整个 workspace（RN-091）。每个游标说明该项目已读到哪个 `seq`，响应携带每个项目最近会话中在此之后的内容。

**之所以用 POST，是因为它是唯一带请求体的动词，而不是因为它改变状态。** 服务器不知道每个读者停在哪里：“读到这里”是存储在浏览器中的每个项目一个 `seq`，并且（刻意地）没有标记为已读的端点。因此截止点需要随请求传递，而这样的对有几十个——放在查询字符串中会变成很长的 URL，代理会截断它，还会把用户的项目 id 写进访问日志。该路由是幂等的且没有副作用：它返回 `200`，绝不返回 `201`。

取代了抽屉打开时每个项目一次的请求——23 个项目要花 286 次/分钟，而限制是 300。

28196f689266.fonte:
The Brabo API. Every endpoint returns JSON, except the four explicitly
documented with a different `content-type` (two SSE ones, the metrics one,
and the OAuth callback, which redirects).

## Authentication

The access token is a **15-minute EdDSA JWT**, presented in
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The public key lives at
`GET /.well-known/jwks.json`.

The refresh **is not** a JWT: it's an opaque token that lives in an
`httpOnly` cookie (`brabo_refresh`, `Path=/auth`, `SameSite=Strict`) and
never appears in any response body. `POST /auth/refresh` and
`POST /auth/logout` read the cookie and require the `X-CSRF-Token` header
to match the `brabo_csrf` cookie.

**Rotation is mandatory.** Each refresh consumes the presented token and
issues another. Re-presenting an already-consumed one is a theft signature
and revokes the WHOLE family — including the legitimate session. A client
that fires two concurrent refreshes takes itself down; use a single in-flight
call.

The `/internal/*` routes are the api ↔ engine surface and sit **outside the
JWT**: they require the `X-Brabo-Service-Token` header with the shared
secret. A user token doesn't open any of them.

## Errors

NestJS default format: `{ "statusCode": number, "message": string | string[], "error": string }`.

| code | when |
|---|---|
| `400` | invalid body — the `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails |
| `401` | no token, expired token, or invalid credential |
| `403` | authenticated but without the role RBAC requires, or a wrong service token |
| `404` | resource doesn't exist **or** is invisible to the caller |
| `409` | state conflict — invalid session transition, resource already exists |
| `429` | rate limit or progressive lockout |

Auth routes respond **deliberately indistinguishably** between a nonexistent
email, a wrong password, and a locked account: same body, same status, same
timing. That's what closes account enumeration, and it's not a diagnostic
defect.

## Rate limit

Sliding window in Postgres: 300 requests per user and 600 per IP every 60s,
configurable. A `@Public()` route and a service route are **exempt** — what
guards `/auth/*` is the progressive lockout, not the rate limit.
28196f689266.traducao:
Brabo API。除了四个明确记录了不同 `content-type` 的端点（两个 SSE 端点、指标端点，以及会重定向的 OAuth 回调）之外，每个端点都返回 JSON。

## 认证

访问令牌是一个 **15 分钟有效的 EdDSA JWT**，通过
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` 出示。公钥位于
`GET /.well-known/jwks.json`。

refresh **不是** JWT：它是一个不透明令牌，存放在
`httpOnly` cookie（`brabo_refresh`、`Path=/auth`、`SameSite=Strict`）中，
从不出现在任何响应体中。`POST /auth/refresh` 和
`POST /auth/logout` 读取该 cookie，并要求 `X-CSRF-Token` 头
与 `brabo_csrf` cookie 一致。

**轮换是强制的。** 每次 refresh 都会消耗所出示的令牌并
签发另一个。重复出示已被消耗的令牌是被盗的特征，
会撤销整个令牌族——包括合法的会话。一个
同时发起两次并发 refresh 的客户端会把自己踢下线；请只保留一个进行中的
调用。

`/internal/*` 路由是 api ↔ engine 之间的接口，位于 **JWT 之外**：
它们要求带有共享机密的 `X-Brabo-Service-Token` 头。
用户令牌打不开其中任何一个。

## 错误

NestJS 默认格式：`{ "statusCode": number, "message": string | string[], "error": string }`。

| 代码 | 何时 |
|---|---|
| `400` | 请求体无效——`ValidationPipe` 以 `whitelist` 和 `forbidNonWhitelisted` 运行，因此未知字段也会失败 |
| `401` | 没有令牌、令牌已过期或凭据无效 |
| `403` | 已认证但没有 RBAC 要求的角色，或服务令牌错误 |
| `404` | 资源不存在**或**对调用方不可见 |
| `409` | 状态冲突——无效的会话状态转换、资源已存在 |
| `429` | 速率限制或渐进式锁定 |

认证路由对不存在的邮箱、错误的密码和被锁定的账户
**刻意给出无法区分的**响应：相同的响应体、相同的状态码、相同的
耗时。这正是防止账户枚举的手段，而不是诊断上的
缺陷。

## 速率限制

基于 Postgres 的滑动窗口：每 60 秒每个用户 300 次请求、每个 IP 600 次请求，
可配置。`@Public()` 路由和服务路由**豁免**——保护
`/auth/*` 的是渐进式锁定，而不是速率限制。

On a PROJECT it OVERRIDES the workspace role in both directions — the effective role is this one whenever the association exists, higher OR lower — and two movements are refused with 403: downgrading a workspace `owner`, and changing your own role (either way). 4d5a7e873cd8.fonte: PRs (`pr_open`/`open_adr_pr`) plus epics, stories and tasks this agent created in the session.
4d5a7e873cd8.traducao: 该代理在会话中创建的 PR（`pr_open`/`open_adr_pr`）以及 epic、story 和任务。

4a3e96b74de7.fonte: Names from the current `module_map`. A module that doesn't exist becomes an architecture pending item.
4a3e96b74de7.traducao: 来自当前 `module_map` 的名称。不存在的模块会变成一项架构待办。

c76b88732a53.fonte: The folder name as chosen in the browser — shown in the coverage panel.
c76b88732a53.traducao: 在浏览器中选择的文件夹名称——显示在覆盖率面板中。

3f911cc37ba3.fonte: Up to 500 files. The exact summed-byte cap (RAG_LOCAL_TOTAL_BYTES_LIMIT) and the per-file extension allowlist are enforced by the use case, not by this DTO — an array of individually-valid strings can still add up to a payload too large.
3f911cc37ba3.traducao: 最多 500 个文件。精确的字节总和上限（RAG_LOCAL_TOTAL_BYTES_LIMIT）和逐文件的扩展名允许列表由用例而不是此 DTO 强制执行——由各自有效的字符串组成的数组加起来仍可能是过大的载荷。

03096ab1e3bf.fonte: Skipped for being over the per-file byte cap or having an unrecognized extension — never fails the whole batch.
03096ab1e3bf.traducao: 因超过单文件字节上限或扩展名无法识别而被跳过——绝不会让整批失败。

b1d3c85c0fcf.fonte: The agent slug or the area key, exactly as requested.
b1d3c85c0fcf.traducao: 代理 slug 或区域键，与请求中的完全一致。

7a53b2ed4779.fonte: The SAME value the single-key route answers for this key — `null` when no level of the cascade has a model.
7a53b2ed4779.traducao: 与单键路由对此键的回答相同的值——当级联的任何层级都没有模型时为 `null`。

04fd162e7611.fonte: One entry per requested agent, in the order requested.
04fd162e7611.traducao: 每个请求的代理一条记录，按请求的顺序。

1b55e34bcc07.fonte: One entry per requested area, in the order requested.
1b55e34bcc07.traducao: 每个请求的区域一条记录，按请求的顺序。

55f227ec7a30.fonte: Free-text diagnosis — a human detail of what happened, not the structured origin of the failure.
55f227ec7a30.traducao: 自由文本诊断——对所发生情况的人类可读细节，而不是失败的结构化来源。

c7cba1a6a130.fonte: The ORIGIN of the failure: `infra`, `modelo`, `codigo`, or `politica`. Never by elimination — this is the lesson from ADR 0020, taken up a level by the QA Lead in ADR 0038. Optional: not every call site knows the origin.
c7cba1a6a130.traducao: 失败的来源：`infra`、`modelo`、`codigo` 或 `politica`。绝不通过排除法——这是 ADR 0020 的教训，由 QA Lead 在 ADR 0038 中提升了一个层次。可选：并非每个调用点都知道来源。

3e5e915c9644.fonte: `extra_branch` is INFORMATIONAL and never blocks: an adopted repository has whatever policy it has, and the bootstrap doesn't delete it.
3e5e915c9644.traducao: `extra_branch` 仅供参考，绝不阻塞：接入的仓库有它自己的策略，引导不会删除它。

fc3769b55927.fonte: `null` when the project has no adopted repository.
fc3769b55927.traducao: 项目没有接入的仓库时为 `null`。

e74fdcedca4a.fonte: `null` = plan generated and NOT yet decided. This is the state in which nothing runs (RN-045).
e74fdcedca4a.traducao: `null` = 计划已生成但尚未决定。这是什么都不会运行的状态（RN-045）。

d44af1d9a1dd.fonte: What the bootstrap WOULD DO. An empty list = the repository is already how the template wants it, and there is nothing to approve.
d44af1d9a1dd.traducao: 引导将会做的事。空列表 = 仓库已经符合模板的要求，没有需要批准的内容。

2750daa94887.fonte: The divergences between the repository and the template.
2750daa94887.traducao: 仓库与模板之间的差异。

81625de61aa8.fonte: The same taxonomy as `proposed_actions` — each approved step becomes a recorded action when the bootstrap runs.
81625de61aa8.traducao: 与 `proposed_actions` 相同的分类——引导运行时，每个已批准的步骤都会成为一条记录的操作。

2a0ad1801a13.fonte: The mutation data: which branch, which file, from where.
2a0ad1801a13.traducao: 变更数据：哪个分支、哪个文件、来自哪里。

891457885046.fonte: Filled in for a project budget; `null` for a session one.
891457885046.traducao: 项目预算时填写；会话预算时为 `null`。

3ef6bbfdb22d.traducao: 上限，以微美元计（50 美元）。

856cde28aea9.fonte: `block` refuses the call when it would exceed the cap; `allow` lets it through and only warns.
856cde28aea9.traducao: `block` 会在调用将超出上限时拒绝它；`allow` 会放行并只发出警告。

fd14254fd9ad.fonte: Highest threshold (70/90/100) already notified. It, not the previous spend, serves as the floor — using the spend would make the same warning fire again on every call after it was crossed.
fd14254fd9ad.traducao: 已经通知过的最高阈值（70/90/100）。用作下限的是它，而不是之前的花费——使用花费会让同一警告在越过阈值后的每次调用中再次触发。

19bd37a32b39.fonte: `person` (default) for whoever operates the system; `external_system` for another system it talks to (e.g. a Git provider).
19bd37a32b39.traducao: `person`（默认）表示操作系统的人；`external_system` 表示与之交互的另一个系统（例如 Git 提供商）。

997512e5f39e.fonte: Mermaid `C4Context` syntax — the system and the external actors.
997512e5f39e.traducao: Mermaid `C4Context` 语法——系统和外部参与者。

6bca4101bfeb.fonte: Mermaid `C4Container` syntax — the current module_map's modules and the dependencies between them.
6bca4101bfeb.traducao: Mermaid `C4Container` 语法——当前 module_map 的模块及其之间的依赖。

4bd15b14ef76.fonte: `delta` carries incremental `text`; `done` closes with the token/cost accounting; `error` aborts; `metering_failed` means the RESPONSE went out but the cost was not accounted for — the frame exists so that failure does not go unnoticed.
4bd15b14ef76.traducao: `delta` 携带增量 `text`；`done` 以 token/成本计费收尾；`error` 中止；`metering_failed` 表示响应已发出但成本没有计入——该帧的存在是为了不让这种失败被忽视。

4f09cc7046a0.traducao: 仅在 `done` 中，以微美元计。

cf865467a636.fonte: Only on `done`. `true` when the provider did not return a count and the cost was ESTIMATED — the number is worth less and the UI needs to be able to say so.
cf865467a636.traducao: 仅在 `done` 中。当提供商没有返回计数、成本是估算出来的时候为 `true`——这个数字的价值较低，界面需要能够说明这一点。

f2b6d6e4f3a9.fonte: What was RECORDED, not what a Docker daemon confirms — no real orchestrator transitions this table today (RN-243).
f2b6d6e4f3a9.traducao: 登记的内容，而不是 Docker 守护进程确认的内容——目前没有真正的编排器转换这张表（RN-243）。

ec790a3ec196.fonte: Version of `artifact.project_image` FROZEN at the first transition (RN-245) — not reapplied on every read.
ec790a3ec196.traducao: 在第一次状态转换时冻结的 `artifact.project_image` 版本（RN-245）——不会在每次读取时重新应用。

059cfea3dd8d.fonte: Cap DECLARED at provisioning time — not enforced (RN-248).
059cfea3dd8d.traducao: 置备时声明的上限——不强制执行（RN-248）。

546f8e9a857c.fonte: Only populated on a transition to `failed`.
546f8e9a857c.traducao: 仅在转换为 `failed` 时填写。

a98f620cb147.fonte: What the Docker daemon reports RIGHT NOW, asked through the broker (ADR 0130) — never fused with the fields above, which are what was RECORDED. A container killed from the outside shows up as recorded `running` and observed `exited`, and that is the point. `null` means either "there is no container" or "I could not look" — read `naoObservado` to tell them apart.
a98f620cb147.traducao: Docker 守护进程此刻报告的内容，经由 broker 查询（ADR 0130）——绝不与上面那些登记的字段合并。从外部被杀掉的容器会显示为登记 `running`、观测 `exited`，这正是要点所在。`null` 表示“没有容器”或“我无法查看”——读取 `naoObservado` 来区分两者。

e8595a366487.fonte: `null` when the observation actually HAPPENED — including when it came back empty, which is the positive statement "I looked and there is no container". Filled in when there was no way to look, saying why. Inheriting the recorded state here is exactly what RN-468 forbids.
e8595a366487.traducao: 当观测确实发生时为 `null`——包括返回为空的情况，那是“我看过了，没有容器”的肯定陈述。无法查看时填写，并说明原因。在这里继承登记状态正是 RN-468 所禁止的。

6bb1336bb1ce.fonte: The broker's own message, when there was one.

1f12b729a5d1.fonte: Only tasks from this module enter the draw.
1f12b729a5d1.traducao: 只有此模块的任务参与抽取。

74d5ff79b701.traducao: 从 1 开始，与所有编辑器的显示一致。

104b6da08339.fonte: The file went past the per-call annotated-lines cap.
104b6da08339.traducao: 文件超过了单次调用的标注行数上限。

9fc6bf26f1fe.fonte: The list was cut at the enriched-branches cap.
9fc6bf26f1fe.traducao: 列表在丰富分支数上限处被截断。

96bd1f648cc2.fonte: Commits ahead of the default branch. `null` when not computable.
96bd1f648cc2.traducao: 领先默认分支的提交数。无法计算时为 `null`。

84b1c3233342.traducao: 落后默认分支的提交数。

6ce33080ad5d.fonte: Dev agent/module owning the branch (RN-152), when the name matches `feature/task-XXXXXXXX` and the task/module are still resolvable. `null` for a user's manual branch or for `main`/`dev`/`qa`.
6ce33080ad5d.traducao: 拥有该分支的 dev agent/模块（RN-152），当名称匹配 `feature/task-XXXXXXXX` 且任务/模块仍可解析时。为 `null` 的情况：用户的手动分支，或 `main`/`dev`/`qa`。

5211960be94b.fonte: agent_id of the dev who created the branch (`dev-<module>`/`dev-<module>-2`, RN-087).
5211960be94b.traducao: 创建该分支的 dev 的 agent_id（`dev-<module>`/`dev-<module>-2`，RN-087）。

5cd7663338de.fonte: Module name, from the project's current `module_map`.
5cd7663338de.traducao: 模块名称，来自项目当前的 `module_map`。

96453fdc9725.fonte: Path AFTER the change (for `removed`, what disappeared).
96453fdc9725.traducao: 变更之后的路径（对 `removed` 而言，是消失的那个）。

ce4d43d189af.fonte: Previous path; only filled in when `status` is `renamed`.
ce4d43d189af.traducao: 之前的路径；仅当 `status` 为 `renamed` 时填写。

2144a4d57673.fonte: The file's unified diff. `null` when the provider doesn't deliver it (binary, or the patch is too large) — distinct from `""`, which is "came back empty". Without this distinction the screen would say "no changes" on a changed binary.
2144a4d57673.traducao: 文件的统一 diff。提供商没有交付时（二进制或补丁过大）为 `null`——与 `""` 不同，后者是“返回为空”。没有这一区分，界面会对一个已更改的二进制文件说“没有变化”。

922abe9a48b5.fonte: The list was cut at the per-diff file cap.
922abe9a48b5.traducao: 列表在单个 diff 的文件数上限处被截断。

60cd595e97b2.fonte: UTF-8 content. Binary is not served by this route.
60cd595e97b2.traducao: UTF-8 内容。此路由不提供二进制文件。

988b80db0ee0.fonte: The file went past the byte cap and `content` is the beginning of it. The tab is read-only: truncating and warning is better than refusing the file.
988b80db0ee0.traducao: 文件超过了字节上限，`content` 是其开头部分。该标签页是只读的：截断并提示比拒绝该文件更好。

7287756cccaa.fonte: Bytes RETURNED — after the cut, not before.
7287756cccaa.traducao: 返回的字节数——截断之后的，而不是之前的。

c3af80205aef.fonte: The list was cut at the per-call PR cap.
c3af80205aef.traducao: 列表在单次调用的 PR 数上限处被截断。

4e3e6aabf139.fonte: Login/username of who opened it. `null` when the provider doesn't report it.
4e3e6aabf139.traducao: 打开者的登录名/用户名。提供商不报告时为 `null`。

06438a7562ca.fonte: `null` when the provider doesn't report it.

dc90e06c39da.fonte: The whole line, trimmed so a minified file is never returned in full.
dc90e06c39da.traducao: 整行内容，经过裁剪，确保压缩后的文件绝不会被完整返回。

eff8b668a7f8.fonte: Files actually opened. This is the search's real cost, and it is in the response so it doesn't stay invisible.
eff8b668a7f8.traducao: 实际打开的文件数。这是搜索的真实成本，放在响应中是为了不让它隐而不见。

d86c343586ae.fonte: The scan stopped by budget (directories, files, or matches) before finishing the tree. Narrow the `path` or the term.
d86c343586ae.traducao: 扫描因预算（目录、文件或匹配）而在遍历完整棵树之前停止。请缩小 `path` 或搜索词的范围。

3b871ea416ae.fonte: Full path from the repository's root.
3b871ea416ae.traducao: 从仓库根目录开始的完整路径。

b6532ee64242.fonte: Bytes. `null` for a directory and when the provider doesn't report it — distinguishing it from `0` matters so the screen never claims "empty file".
b6532ee64242.traducao: 字节数。目录以及提供商不报告时为 `null`——与 `0` 区分很重要，这样界面绝不会声称“空文件”。

abcf3f30d234.traducao: 读取的分支、tag 或 sha。

4fd837775f52.traducao: 列出的目录；`""` 即根目录。

62d337ec48ae.fonte: The listing was cut at the per-level entry cap. There is more in the directory than what came back here.
62d337ec48ae.traducao: 列表在每层条目数上限处被截断。目录中的内容比这里返回的更多。

a4d6ce12e42a.fonte: ADDED to the rules the story already cites (completing never unlinks a rule); each new id has to reference an existing `artifact.business_rule`.
a4d6ce12e42a.traducao: 追加到 story 已引用的规则中（补全绝不会解除规则的关联）；每个新 id 都必须引用一个已存在的 `artifact.business_rule`。

aa4fc6d86f1d.fonte: RN-859 (ADR 0214): an open question the user ALREADY answered — only then a `ready` story (no task in execution) can be corrected.
aa4fc6d86f1d.traducao: RN-859（ADR 0214）：一个用户已经回答过的未决问题——只有这样，`ready` story（没有执行中的任务）才能被修正。

d47f094d6f45.fonte: `confirmado`: the Infra was triggered. `ja_oferecido`: it already had a pending offer or was active in the project — nothing was recorded nor asked of the engine (double click, second tab). The Dev Lead is no longer a target here: the Infra offers it once the container is `running` (RN-672).
d47f094d6f45.traducao: `confirmado`：Infra 已被触发。`ja_oferecido`：它已有待处理的提议或已在项目中活跃——没有记录任何内容，也没有向 engine 请求任何东西（双击、第二个标签页）。这里不再以 Dev Lead 为目标：一旦容器处于 `running`，由 Infra 向其提议（RN-672）。

d97c87f622f5.fonte: Absolute path confirmed by the runner ON THE HOST — the source of truth (RN-423). Re-validated LEXICALLY here before writing; invalid is 400, never written.
d97c87f622f5.traducao: runner 在宿主机上确认的绝对路径——事实来源（RN-423）。写入之前在此进行词法重新校验；无效时返回 400，绝不写入。

1c1b941e6e90.fonte: The project's most recent session (`ProjectSession.latest_id/1`), resolved on the engine side. `null`/omitted when the project doesn't have any session yet — the project is still updated, only the audit event is skipped (accepted gap, RN-423).
1c1b941e6e90.traducao: 项目最近的会话（`ProjectSession.latest_id/1`），在 engine 端解析。项目还没有任何会话时为 `null`/省略——项目仍会被更新，只是跳过审计事件（已接受的缺口，RN-423）。

48440aed853e.fonte: Who requested the runner ticket (owner of the socket that confirmed) — becomes the actor of the `project.workspace_verified` event. Omitted: the event (if there is a session) is born with no identified actor.
48440aed853e.traducao: 请求 runner 票据的人（确认路径的套接字的所有者）——成为 `project.workspace_verified` 事件的参与者。省略时：该事件（如果有会话）诞生时没有可识别的参与者。

d0a517177288.fonte: Always `true` when the call did not throw — confirmation is idempotent. `changed` says whether ANYTHING changed on this call.
d0a517177288.traducao: 只要调用没有抛出异常就始终为 `true`——确认是幂等的。`changed` 说明这次调用是否改变了任何东西。

a4dd082470d3.fonte: The WRITTEN (normalized) path — can differ from what creation had, because the runner is the source of truth and overwrites it.
a4dd082470d3.traducao: 写入的（规范化后的）路径——可能与创建时的不同，因为 runner 是事实来源并会覆盖它。

04ef12648b90.fonte: `true` on the first confirmation, or when the reported path is DIFFERENT from what was already written. `false` on a reconnection that reports the same path as always — nothing was rewritten.
04ef12648b90.traducao: 第一次确认时，或报告的路径与已写入的不同时为 `true`。重新连接时报告的路径与以往相同则为 `false`——没有重写任何内容。

8eb3ebff3139.fonte: The shell command, interpreted by `sh -c` INSIDE the container — same convention as the terminal action run outside one.
8eb3ebff3139.traducao: shell 命令，由 `sh -c` 在容器内解释——与在容器外运行的终端操作约定相同。

e6c4f6e2fc0e.fonte: Working directory INSIDE the container. Already translated from the host path by the engine (RN-492) — this DTO doesn't repeat that translation. Omitted runs at `/work`, the project root. The broker re-validates it is inside `/work` and refuses (`DiretorioForaDoEscopoError`) otherwise.
e6c4f6e2fc0e.traducao: 容器内的工作目录。已由 engine 从宿主机路径转换（RN-492）——此 DTO 不会重复该转换。省略时在 `/work`（项目根目录）运行。broker 会重新校验它位于 `/work` 内，否则拒绝（`DiretorioForaDoEscopoError`）。

a6045a222ce5.fonte: Timeout in milliseconds. Omitted uses the broker default.
a6045a222ce5.traducao: 超时时间，以毫秒计。省略时使用 broker 的默认值。

3b8add966613.fonte: `false` quando o broker recusou ou não respondeu — os outros campos ficam ausentes e `motivo` explica.
3b8add966613.traducao: 当 broker 拒绝或没有响应时为 `false`——其他字段缺失，由 `motivo` 解释原因。

75170d0a772c.fonte: Where this project's container comes up (RN-497/503). `container` and `mounted` go through the broker, on the server; `runner` goes through the local agent on the user's machine. It is what branches the start action between `container_start` and `container_start_via_runner`.
75170d0a772c.traducao: 此项目的容器在哪里启动（RN-497/503）。`container` 和 `mounted` 通过服务器上的 broker；`runner` 通过用户机器上的本地代理。正是它让启动操作在 `container_start` 和 `container_start_via_runner` 之间分支。

c546538d5af2.fonte: `null` means this project NEVER provisioned a container — a THIRD state, not a `status` value: it is neither `stopped` (a container that existed and stopped) nor "could not be observed" (which is about the daemon). Read `naoVerificado: "sem_container_registrado"` alongside it.
c546538d5af2.traducao: `null` 表示此项目从未置备过容器——这是第三种状态，而不是 `status` 的一个值：它既不是 `stopped`（曾经存在后来停止的容器），也不是“无法观测”（那是关于守护进程的）。请同时读取 `naoVerificado: "sem_container_registrado"`。

7e8e55e0735a.fonte: Whether ANY `artifact.project_image` exists for this project — the RN-105 gate, which since RN-494/ADR 0135 applies to all THREE modes. `false` means starting a container is impossible right now, and the page says so instead of proposing an action that is known to fail.
7e8e55e0735a.traducao: 此项目是否存在任何 `artifact.project_image`——RN-105 gate，自 RN-494/ADR 0135 起适用于全部三种模式。`false` 表示此刻无法启动容器，页面会说明这一点，而不是提议一个注定失败的操作。

b710e7d10943.fonte: When a runner CONFIRMED the folder (RN-423) — only meaningful for `executionMode: "runner"`. It records ONE confirmation and is never a heartbeat (RN-468): non-null does NOT prove a local agent is connected now. What it does prove is the negative — `null` on a `runner` project means no runner ever connected.
b710e7d10943.traducao: runner 确认文件夹的时间（RN-423）——仅对 `executionMode: "runner"` 有意义。它记录的是一次确认，绝不是心跳（RN-468）：非空并不能证明本地代理此刻已连接。它能证明的是否定的一面——值为 `null` 时（在 `runner` 项目上）表示从未有 runner 连接过。

26534169fedb.fonte: What the broker reports right now — `null` either because there is no container, because it could not be asked (`naoObservado`), or because this row was not asked this load (`naoVerificado`).
26534169fedb.traducao: broker 此刻报告的内容——为 `null` 可能是因为没有容器、因为无法询问（`naoObservado`），或因为本次加载没有询问这一行（`naoVerificado`）。

2c1a2c1e10ac.fonte: Non-null when this row was NOT asked of the broker this load — never confused with `naoObservado`, which means it WAS asked and failed. `fora_do_escopo_da_verificacao`: status is `stopped`/`failed`/`removed`, where daemon confirmation does not matter. `teto_de_verificacoes_atingido`: eligible, but the per-load broker call budget was already spent by other rows. `sem_container_registrado`: the project never provisioned one, so there is nothing to observe — and it never spends a call from the budget either.
2c1a2c1e10ac.traducao: 当本次加载没有向 broker 询问这一行时非空——绝不与 `naoObservado` 混淆，后者表示询问过但失败了。`fora_do_escopo_da_verificacao`：状态为 `stopped`/`failed`/`removed`，守护进程的确认无关紧要。`teto_de_verificacoes_atingido`：符合条件，但本次加载的 broker 调用预算已被其他行用完。`sem_container_registrado`：项目从未置备过容器，因此没有可观测的东西——它也从不消耗预算中的调用。

495c82fadfcd.fonte: The pending `container_start`/`container_stop`/`container_remove`/`container_start_via_runner` action for this project, if any — in ANY of its sessions. The page renders the inline `ApprovalCard` for it instead of the action button, same pattern as the PRs tab.
495c82fadfcd.traducao: 此项目待处理的 `container_start`/`container_stop`/`container_remove`/`container_start_via_runner` 操作（如有）——在它的任何会话中。页面为其渲染内联的 `ApprovalCard`，而不是操作按钮，与 PR 标签页的模式相同。

5b332ed32d2d.fonte: Whether THIS INSTALLATION has a container broker configured (`BROKER_URL` set, ADR 0130) — the same value on every row, because it is installation configuration and not a property of the project. `container` and `mounted` projects only start a container through the broker (ADR 0144), so with `false` the page refuses the start button for them BEFORE the click and says why (ADR 0161, RN-574); `runner` projects are unaffected. It says the variable exists, never that the broker answers — that is what `naoObservado` reports.
5b332ed32d2d.traducao: 此安装是否配置了容器 broker（已设置 `BROKER_URL`，ADR 0130）——每一行的值都相同，因为它是安装配置而不是项目的属性。`container` 和 `mounted` 项目只通过 broker 启动容器（ADR 0144），因此为 `false` 时，页面会在点击之前就为它们拒绝启动按钮并说明原因（ADR 0161，RN-574）；`runner` 项目不受影响。它说明的是变量存在，而绝不是 broker 有响应——那是 `naoObservado` 报告的内容。

fff355cf37e0.fonte: Folder name FROZEN at project creation (RN-109). It is the single source of the container name (`brabo-<workspaceDirName>`) in ALL three modes. Where the FOLDER is is a different question, answered by `localizacao` (RN-503) — the api still never sends an absolute path, because a path from inside the api container is not a path the Docker daemon can resolve.
fff355cf37e0.traducao: 在项目创建时冻结的文件夹名称（RN-109）。在全部三种模式中，它都是容器名称（`brabo-<workspaceDirName>`）的唯一来源。文件夹在哪里是另一个问题，由 `localizacao`（RN-503）回答——api 仍然从不发送绝对路径，因为来自 api 容器内部的路径不是 Docker 守护进程能够解析的路径。

ce5f15fcf712.fonte: Where the code lives. The broker serves `container` AND `mounted` (RN-503): since ADR 0141 the mounted folder lives under one base this server mounts by identity, so the daemon reaches it. It still refuses `runner`: that folder is on the user's machine and no root here sees it — there, the runner is what brings a container up (ADR 0137).
ce5f15fcf712.traducao: 代码所在的位置。broker 服务于 `container` 和 `mounted`（RN-503）：自 ADR 0141 起，挂载的文件夹位于此服务器按身份挂载的一个基目录下，因此守护进程可以访问它。它仍然拒绝 `runner`：那个文件夹在用户的机器上，这里没有任何根目录能看到它——在那里，启动容器的是 runner（ADR 0137）。

f488c1c3f7b3.fonte: The discriminated locator of the project folder (RN-503): which of the broker's two roots resolves it, and the relative segment to join to that root.
f488c1c3f7b3.traducao: 项目文件夹的可辨识定位符（RN-503）：由 broker 两个根目录中的哪一个解析它，以及要拼接到该根目录的相对段。

e0ccabe76c05.fonte: The OWNER of the project folder, measured by the api (ADR 0180): the broker starts the container with `--user uid:gid` so the dev agent can write to the folder under `--cap-drop ALL`. `null` when the folder cannot be measured, the project is `runner`, or the owner is root — the container then starts as before. Never accepted from a request to the broker.
e0ccabe76c05.traducao: 项目文件夹的所有者，由 api 测量（ADR 0180）：broker 以 `--user uid:gid` 启动容器，使 dev agent 在 `--cap-drop ALL` 下仍能写入该文件夹。为 `null` 的情况：文件夹无法测量、项目为 `runner`，或所有者是 root——此时容器像以前一样启动。绝不接受来自对 broker 请求中的值。

3387e3ba8440.fonte: `null` while the Architect has not decided (RN-105) — `start` is then refused with 409 on the broker side, and the other four operations still work.
3387e3ba8440.traducao: 在 Architect 尚未做出决定时为 `null`（RN-105）——此时 `start` 在 broker 端会以 409 拒绝，其他四个操作仍然可用。

f380d07e0ad2.fonte: Version of the current artifact; 0 when there is no decision. It ends up on the container as the `brabo.image.version` label.
f380d07e0ad2.traducao: 当前制品的版本；没有决定时为 0。它最终作为 `brabo.image.version` 标签出现在容器上。

bde4aa31c1ce.fonte: Module name — must exist in the current module_map.
bde4aa31c1ce.traducao: 模块名称——必须存在于当前的 module_map 中。

72bc3f01ff7c.fonte: What the module exposes to whoever depends on it. 1 to 40.
72bc3f01ff7c.traducao: 该模块向依赖它的一方暴露的内容。1 到 40 项。

46d2aefe4f19.fonte: The current module_map's `dependsOn`: what this module CONSUMES.
46d2aefe4f19.traducao: 当前 module_map 的 `dependsOn`：此模块消费的内容。

e7b9d7ccd810.fonte: What it exposes. `null` = the Architect declared no contract for this module (different from exposing nothing).
e7b9d7ccd810.traducao: 它暴露的内容。`null` = Architect 没有为此模块声明契约（不同于什么都不暴露）。

629003985ff3.fonte: One per module of the CURRENT module_map, in map order.
629003985ff3.traducao: 当前 module_map 的每个模块一条，按映射顺序。

87e2a48ff32e.fonte: Contracts of modules the current module_map no longer has — said, never attached to a module that does not exist.
87e2a48ff32e.traducao: 当前 module_map 已不再包含的模块的契约——会被说明，绝不会挂到一个不存在的模块上。

37083255c7d2.fonte: O novo modo de execução. Pode repetir o modo atual do projeto — nesse caso, só `workspacePath` muda de verdade.
37083255c7d2.traducao: 新的执行模式。可以与项目当前的模式相同——这种情况下，真正改变的只有 `workspacePath`。

acda20ec05b1.fonte: O caminho absoluto da pasta do usuário — obrigatório quando `executionMode` é `mounted` ou `runner`, recusado quando é `container`. Mesma validação da criação (RN-170/RN-422/RN-423): em `mounted`, precisa existir e ser gravável de dentro do container; em `runner`, só o formato é validado agora — a confirmação de verdade vem do runner conectando de novo.
acda20ec05b1.traducao: 用户文件夹的绝对路径——当 `executionMode` 为 `mounted` 或 `runner` 时必需，为 `container` 时拒绝。与创建时的校验相同（RN-170/RN-422/RN-423）：在 `mounted` 中，它必须存在且可从容器内写入；在 `runner` 中，现在只校验格式——真正的确认来自 runner 重新连接。

571df21d08b2.fonte: How many rules have no story at all. Each one is a discovery.
571df21d08b2.traducao: 有多少条规则完全没有 story。每一条都是一项发现。

444922eda3a6.fonte: Always an agent on this route.
444922eda3a6.traducao: 在此路由上始终是代理。

46780185004e.fonte: System/project name, for the diagram's label.
46780185004e.traducao: 系统/项目名称，用作图的标签。

1733861d5b0d.fonte: External actors of the Context level (Simon Brown). The Container level's containers do NOT go here: they come from the project's current module_map.
1733861d5b0d.traducao: Context 层级的外部参与者（Simon Brown）。Container 层级的容器不放在这里：它们来自项目当前的 module_map。

addfc1ac9af9.fonte: Business rules covered. This is where rule→story coverage is computed in `GET /projects/:id/coverage`.
addfc1ac9af9.traducao: 所覆盖的业务规则。规则→story 的覆盖情况就是根据这里在 `GET /projects/:id/coverage` 中计算的。

db2a33b31eb2.fonte: Modules from the `module_map` that the story touches. A story with no module, or with a non-existent module, becomes an architecture pending item.
db2a33b31eb2.traducao: story 涉及的来自 `module_map` 的模块。没有模块或模块不存在的 story 会变成一项架构待办。

cb646ec7c3dc.fonte: The PO finished the story and it's waiting on the user's decision (Phase 12c — RN-048). Coexists with `status: "draft"`: it is a proposal, not a state. Always `false` in a project in `auto` mode.
cb646ec7c3dc.traducao: PO 已完成该 story，正在等待用户的决定（Phase 12c——RN-048）。与 `status: "draft"` 共存：它是一个提议，不是一个状态。始终为 `false`，如果项目处于 `auto` 模式。

cf8ac6e9b38f.fonte: Why the user returned the story to the PO. `null` when it was never returned.
cf8ac6e9b38f.traducao: 用户为何把 story 退回给 PO。从未被退回时为 `null`。

154057f24977.fonte: When the story was ARCHIVED (RN-727). Archived stories leave the backlog, the coverage, the plan and the claim; `null` is a story in play.
154057f24977.traducao: story 被归档的时间（RN-727）。已归档的 story 离开 backlog、覆盖、计划和认领；`null` 表示仍在进行中的 story。

6958e0b863c3.fonte: Why it was archived, when someone said (RN-727).
6958e0b863c3.traducao: 归档的原因，如果有人说明的话（RN-727）。

07c6fe33859d.fonte: ULID of the session_event for the artifact that motivated the handoff.
07c6fe33859d.traducao: 引发该 handoff 的制品对应的 session_event 的 ULID。

4082366024e1.fonte: Only if nobody got it yet (ADR 0182, RN-636): with a pending offer to the target in ANY session of the project, return it (`desfecho: ja_oferecido`) instead of replacing it. AppSec sends it.
4082366024e1.traducao: 仅当还没有人拿到时（ADR 0182，RN-636）：如果项目的任何会话中已有给该目标的待处理提议，则返回它（`desfecho: ja_oferecido`）而不是替换它。AppSec 会发送这个字段。

ea69a5a6f2dc.fonte: Module graph. A CYCLE makes the map get rejected with 400 — the validation is domain-level. Each module may declare `resources` (cpus, memoryMb, pidsLimit — all three or none); a partial declaration, a value above the container ceiling, or a SUM over modules above it is also 400 (RN-683).
ea69a5a6f2dc.traducao: 模块图。存在环会使映射以 400 被拒绝——校验在领域层。每个模块可以声明 `resources`（cpus、memoryMb、pidsLimit——三项全有或全无）；部分声明、超过容器上限的值，或模块总和超过上限，同样返回 400（RN-683）。

29ae0cfe1c40.fonte: Circuit breaker (Phase 12b — RN-047): how many consecutive tasks ending blocked stop the module's dev agent at idle_tripped. Omitted uses the domain default (DEFAULT_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_BLOCKED). Applies from the NEXT execution activation onward — doesn't affect agents already running.
29ae0cfe1c40.traducao: 熔断器（Phase 12b——RN-047）：连续多少个任务以阻塞结束会让该模块的 dev agent 停在 idle_tripped。省略时使用领域默认值（DEFAULT_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_BLOCKED）。从下一次激活执行起生效——不影响已在运行的代理。

9d4baa560379.fonte: Who promotes a story from `draft` to `ready` (Phase 12c — RN-048). `auto` (new-project default since RN-659): a complete story is already born `ready`, with no human step. `manual`: the PO proposes and YOU decide, in the Backlog tab. Changing the default did not rewrite any existing project. The domain validations (DoD/DoR/RF/rule/modules) are the SAME in both modes; the mode only changes who triggers it.
9d4baa560379.traducao: 谁把 story 从 `draft` 提升为 `ready`（Phase 12c——RN-048）。`auto`（自 RN-659 起为新项目的默认值）：完整的 story 一出生就是 `ready`，没有人工步骤。`manual`：PO 提议，由你在 Backlog 标签页中决定。更改默认值并没有改写任何已有项目。领域校验（DoD/DoR/RF/规则/模块）在两种模式下完全相同；模式只改变由谁触发。

6d5b00404383.fonte: WHERE this project's command EXECUTES (RN-169/RN-421 — ADR 0072/0104). `container` (default): the folder managed by the product inside PROJECT_WORKSPACES_ROOT, the usual behavior. `mounted`: a folder of YOURS, given in `workspacePath`, inside the installation-wide base `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE` (ADR 0141) — creation validates only the path FORMAT plus that base, and the folder itself is created later, when Infra starts the container (RN-501, ADR 0142). `runner`: a folder of YOURS that does NOT need a bind-mount — creation only validates the path format and the project is born "unverified"; run `brabo-runner --project <id> --dir <folder>` on your machine to confirm it (RN-423).
6d5b00404383.traducao: 此项目的命令在哪里执行（RN-169/RN-421——ADR 0072/0104）。`container`（默认）：由产品管理、位于 PROJECT_WORKSPACES_ROOT 内的文件夹，即通常的行为。`mounted`：你自己的一个文件夹，在 `workspacePath` 中给出，位于安装范围的基目录 `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE` 内（ADR 0141）——创建时只校验路径格式和该基目录，文件夹本身稍后在 Infra 启动容器时创建（RN-501，ADR 0142）。`runner`：你自己的一个不需要 bind-mount 的文件夹——创建时只校验路径格式，项目以“未验证”状态诞生；在你的机器上运行 `brabo-runner --project <id> --dir <folder>` 来确认它（RN-423）。

197bf63295c2.fonte: The folder's ABSOLUTE path, required when `executionMode` is `mounted` or `runner`, and refused when it is `container`. In BOTH of them only the FORMAT is validated now — absolute, no `..`, not the system root, not a system folder, not overlapping the Brabo checkout (RN-422/RN-423). `mounted` adds one rule: it must sit inside `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE`, the single folder of your machine the Brabo containers can see (ADR 0141) — with no base configured the mode is not available on this installation and creation says so. Disk is touched later: by the runner in `runner`, and when Infra starts the container in `mounted` (RN-501, ADR 0142).
197bf63295c2.traducao: 文件夹的绝对路径，当 `executionMode` 为 `mounted` 或 `runner` 时必需，为 `container` 时拒绝。在这两种模式中，现在都只校验格式——绝对路径、不含 `..`、不是系统根目录、不是系统文件夹、不与 Brabo 检出目录重叠（RN-422/RN-423）。`mounted` 增加一条规则：它必须位于 `BRABO_PROJECTS_BASE` 内，那是你机器上 Brabo 容器唯一能看到的文件夹（ADR 0141）——没有配置基目录时，此安装不提供该模式，创建时会说明这一点。磁盘稍后才会被触及：在 `runner` 中由 runner 触及，在 `mounted` 中在 Infra 启动容器时触及（RN-501，ADR 0142）。

4093c29acf0c.fonte: The PROJECT's language (RN-619) — shared artifacts and turns with no human author use it. Any BCP-47 code the server recognizes, stored canonical; an unrecognized one is a 400. Omitted, the project starts with its creator's effective response language (RN-618: account choice > confirmed detection > interface language).
4093c29acf0c.traducao: 项目的语言（RN-619）——共享制品和没有人类作者的回合使用它。服务器能识别的任何 BCP-47 代码，以规范形式存储；无法识别的返回 400。省略时，项目以其创建者的有效回复语言开始（RN-618：账户选择 > 已确认的检测 > 界面语言）。

df95c3d3dc58.fonte: The session's intent. `consultiva` (consultative) is conversation only; `criativa` (creative) is the one that produces — it opens ideation with the Creative agent and is the only one that enters execution. REQUIRED: without it the response is 400, because the type is the opener's choice and gets recorded.
df95c3d3dc58.traducao: 会话的意图。`consultiva`（咨询式）只是对话；`criativa`（创作式）是产出的那种——它与 Creative 代理开启构思，并且是唯一会进入执行的。必需：没有它响应为 400，因为类型是开启者的选择并会被记录。

2224d672b4ee.fonte: Friendly name, optional. Does not replace the id's hashtag — screens compose the two. Blank counts as absent.
2224d672b4ee.traducao: 友好名称，可选。不会取代 id 的井号标签——界面会把两者组合起来。空白视为缺省。

04d99750e984.fonte: `heartbeat` requires the `viewer` role; `terminal` requires `developer` — the same minimum role as `MIN_ROLE_FOR_ACTION_TYPE.terminal`.
04d99750e984.traducao: `heartbeat` 需要 `viewer` 角色；`terminal` 需要 `developer`——与 `MIN_ROLE_FOR_ACTION_TYPE.terminal` 的最低角色相同。

af0507888f64.fonte: Each id needs to reference an `artifact.business_rule` event that EXISTS — a made-up id is refused.
af0507888f64.traducao: 每个 id 都必须引用一个确实存在的 `artifact.business_rule` 事件——编造的 id 会被拒绝。

1b447715b737.fonte: kebab-case. Unique in the system and visible in the URL.
1b447715b737.traducao: kebab-case。在系统中唯一，并在 URL 中可见。

bded8708a170.fonte: The credential exists TODAY. `false` is historical spend from a key that was already removed — the consumption happened and does not disappear from the report because of that.
bded8708a170.traducao: 该凭据今天仍然存在。`false` 是来自已被移除的密钥的历史花费——消耗确实发生过，不会因此从报告中消失。

cee868b8d412.fonte: Portion spent by AGENTS — the tab RN-058 started charging to the owner.
cee868b8d412.traducao: 由代理花费的部分——RN-058 开始记在所有者账上的那一部分。

9b24aab72aba.fonte: Portion spent by PEOPLE in chat. Comes from the same key, and it is a different question.
9b24aab72aba.traducao: 由人在聊天中花费的部分。来自同一把密钥，回答的是另一个问题。

70f287bab798.fonte: Owner of the keys — who funds this workspace's agents (RN-058).
70f287bab798.traducao: 密钥的所有者——为此 workspace 的代理出资的人（RN-058）。

be6541b85a08.fonte: `ok` — the provider accepted the credential. `recusado` — the provider rejected it (invalid/revoked key, no balance, network). `nao_suportado` — this provider has no verified test endpoint (`ollama`, `anthropic`, `openai`): NOTHING was verified, and saying "ok" here would be a lie.
be6541b85a08.traducao: `ok`——提供商接受了该凭据。`recusado`——提供商拒绝了它（密钥无效/已撤销、余额不足、网络问题）。`nao_suportado`——此提供商没有经过验证的测试端点（`ollama`、`anthropic`、`openai`）：什么都没有被验证，在这里说“ok”就是撒谎。

95069aa8757f.fonte: Only on `recusado` — the reason the provider gave.
95069aa8757f.traducao: 仅在 `recusado` 时——提供商给出的原因。

c42f9a1334ef.fonte: Rules cited by at least one story — equal to `regras`.
c42f9a1334ef.traducao: 至少被一个 story 引用的规则——等于 `regras`。

a2ab566c6e0a.fonte: `local`: the project already had a `local` repository. `a_provisionar_local`: none yet — the accept provisions a `local` one.
a2ab566c6e0a.traducao: `local`：项目已经有一个 `local` 仓库。`a_provisionar_local`：还没有——接受时会置备一个 `local` 仓库。

d61138aa7a27.fonte: The `generatedAt` of the plan you SAW. Optimistic lock: if the plan has been regenerated since then (re-adoption, or the repository changed), the decision is refused with 409 instead of applying a yes given about something else.
d61138aa7a27.traducao: 你所看到的计划的 `generatedAt`。乐观锁：如果计划自那以后已被重新生成（重新接入，或仓库发生了变化），决定会以 409 拒绝，而不是把针对别的东西给出的同意应用上去。

422ef1aaa83c.fonte: Where the bootstrap ended up. On `skip` the cursor does NOT advance: no step ran, and the record says so.
422ef1aaa83c.traducao: 引导最终停在哪里。在 `skip` 时游标不会前进：没有任何步骤运行，记录也如此说明。

dc2cae8b5fdf.fonte: OCI reference with an explicit TAG or digest. `latest` is REFUSED with 400 — the rule is domain-level.
dc2cae8b5fdf.traducao: 带有显式 TAG 或 digest 的 OCI 引用。`latest` 会以 400 拒绝——该规则位于领域层。

b26cc24862f6.fonte: Why this image. Minimum of 10 characters.
b26cc24862f6.traducao: 为什么选这个镜像。至少 10 个字符。

f8f61da3415e.fonte: The container's network posture. `none` is the default, and it is what makes "inside, the agent is free" a safe sentence.
f8f61da3415e.traducao: 容器的网络姿态。`none` 是默认值，正是它让“在里面，代理是自由的”成为一句安全的话。

5834dd6381cf.fonte: Resource cap. Above the maximum, the decision is REFUSED, never silently downgraded.
5834dd6381cf.traducao: 资源上限。超过最大值时，决定会被拒绝，绝不会被悄悄降级。

9f087cd39028.fonte: OCI reference with an explicit TAG or digest. `latest` is refused: the artifact needs to say the same thing six months from now.
9f087cd39028.traducao: 带有显式 TAG 或 digest 的 OCI 引用。`latest` 被拒绝：制品需要在六个月后仍然表达同样的意思。

93d0919b0bbb.fonte: Why THIS image. This is what makes the decision reviewable.
93d0919b0bbb.traducao: 为什么是这个镜像。正是这一点让决定可以被评审。

7df512aaddb5.fonte: The container's network posture, decided ONCE in the artifact and not command by command. `egress` is cost and surface: the Architect asks, the user authorizes it at provisioning time.
7df512aaddb5.traducao: 容器的网络姿态，在制品中一次性决定，而不是逐条命令决定。`egress` 意味着成本和攻击面：Architect 提出请求，用户在置备时授权。

d762807f57ae.fonte: The WHOLE contract list: each call is a new version that replaces the previous one. What a module CONSUMES is not here — it is derived from the current module_map's `dependsOn` when read.
d762807f57ae.traducao: 完整的契约列表：每次调用都是一个新版本，替换上一个版本。模块消费的内容不在这里——它在读取时由当前 module_map 的 `dependsOn` 推导而来。

2bd2fde9ba7b.fonte: null when the area has no backlog task behind it (Infra, Phase 8c).
2bd2fde9ba7b.traducao: 当区域背后没有 backlog 任务时为 null（Infra，Phase 8c）。

c73d11297ef7.fonte: Stays in the event log alongside the denial. Optional, but recommended.
c73d11297ef7.traducao: 与拒绝一起保存在事件日志中。可选，但建议填写。

a492ac6fd8fe.fonte: Flagged by the Architect. Becomes an informative checklist in SecOps's verdict — there's no line-by-line correlation, and claiming there were would misrepresent the depth of the check.
a492ac6fd8fe.traducao: 由 Architect 标记。会成为 SecOps 裁决中的一份参考清单——没有逐行对应关系，声称有的话会歪曲检查的深度。

53760e9586f6.fonte: ADRs that apply: the cross-cutting ones (no module declared) plus the ones that cite this agent's module.
53760e9586f6.traducao: 适用的 ADR：横切的那些（未声明模块）加上引用此代理模块的那些。

deeae5a59cfa.fonte: The other tasks of the same story, with their status. The QA gate judges the delivery by what belongs to THIS task; a requirement of a sibling task is an observation, never a rejection (RN-765).
deeae5a59cfa.traducao: 同一 story 的其他任务及其状态。QA gate 按属于此任务的内容评判交付；兄弟任务的需求只是一条观察，绝不是拒绝的理由（RN-765）。

365ee88e1937.fonte: Tasks of OTHER stories of the same module that are not done yet, with the story title (at most 20). A requirement that depends on what another story will deliver is an observation for the QA gate, never a rejection (RN-785).
365ee88e1937.traducao: 同一模块中其他 story 尚未完成的任务，附 story 标题（最多 20 个）。依赖于另一个 story 将交付内容的需求，对 QA gate 而言只是一条观察，绝不是拒绝的理由（RN-785）。

4f4c6272ed77.fonte: Real number of open tasks of the module in other stories — larger than `moduleOpenTasks.length` when the list was cut.
4f4c6272ed77.traducao: 该模块在其他 story 中未完成任务的真实数量——当列表被截断时大于 `moduleOpenTasks.length`。

12ced586b1cc.fonte: The current contract of the task module (`artifact.module_contracts`) — the source of the INTERFACE for the QA gate. When the story and the contract diverge, the verdict names the divergence instead of rejecting the dev that followed the contract (RN-786). `null` without a resolvable module or contract.
12ced586b1cc.traducao: 任务所属模块的当前契约（`artifact.module_contracts`）——QA gate 的接口来源。当 story 与契约不一致时，裁决会指出这一差异，而不是拒绝遵循了契约的 dev（RN-786）。没有可解析的模块或契约时为 `null`。

9b2c6271ccd6.fonte: Whether this is the FIRST task of the module: the oldest `backlog.task_claimed` of the project for `module` is this task. The engine gives it twice the per-task budget (RN-774). `false` without `module`.
9b2c6271ccd6.traducao: 这是否是该模块的第一个任务：项目中最早的那个 `backlog.task_claimed`（针对 `module`）就是此任务。engine 会给它两倍的单任务预算（RN-774）。值为 `false`，如果没有 `module`。

852be1d2394b.fonte: RN-859: the user's decisions tied to this task, its story or its rules by `afeta` — they win over RF/DoR on conflict. Newest first, at most 10, each text cut at 1,500 characters.
852be1d2394b.traducao: RN-859：通过 `afeta` 与此任务、其 story 或其规则关联的用户决定——发生冲突时优先于 RF/DoR。最新的在前，最多 10 条，每条文本截断为 1,500 个字符。

f4bc4fb85f3a.fonte: RN-872 (ADR 0215): the project's OTHER decisions — those whose `afeta` does not touch this task. Separate section, inside the SAME cap of 10 as `decisoes` (task decisions take the cap first), newest first.
f4bc4fb85f3a.traducao: RN-872（ADR 0215）：项目的其他决定——即 `afeta` 不涉及此任务的那些。单独的部分，与 `decisoes` 共用同一个 10 条上限（任务决定优先占用上限），最新的在前。

7c03bde560a9.fonte: `sem_diagrama` is the initial state: the Architect has not generated one yet.
7c03bde560a9.traducao: `sem_diagrama` 是初始状态：Architect 还没有生成图。

7bf904021ab3.fonte: The current diagram, or `null` while there is none.
7bf904021ab3.traducao: 当前的图，或在还没有时为 `null`。

55dd3b4d6931.fonte: Version of the current artifact; 0 when there is no diagram. Revising means generating again — history is never rewritten.
55dd3b4d6931.traducao: 当前制品的版本；没有图时为 0。修订意味着重新生成——历史从不被改写。

69f8307f26af.fonte: `sem_decisao` is the initial state of every project and is what closes the RN-105 gate: no image means no container, and the Code tab doesn't open.
69f8307f26af.traducao: `sem_decisao` 是每个项目的初始状态，正是它关闭了 RN-105 gate：没有镜像就没有容器，Code 标签页也无法打开。

a411b304372e.fonte: The current decision, or `null` when there is none yet.
a411b304372e.traducao: 当前的决定，或在还没有时为 `null`。

b36fddeae8e2.fonte: Version of the current artifact; 0 when there is no decision. Revising means issuing a new version — history is never rewritten.
b36fddeae8e2.traducao: 当前制品的版本；没有决定时为 0。修订意味着发出新版本——历史从不被改写。

142afb93c18f.fonte: Id of the event that fixed the current decision, for auditing.
142afb93c18f.traducao: 确定当前决定的事件 id，用于审计。

d51164d7ecb5.fonte: Modules of the `module_map` that got a dev agent. One agent per module, each in an isolated worktree.
d51164d7ecb5.traducao: 获得 dev agent 的 `module_map` 模块。每个模块一个代理，各自位于隔离的 worktree 中。

6e3483ec09dc.fonte: The owner e-mail, typed at the TTY. Normalized before anything is written; it is what the installer records in its marker, since an e-mail identifies and is not a secret.
6e3483ec09dc.traducao: 所有者的邮箱，在 TTY 中输入。在写入任何内容之前进行规范化；安装器会把它记录在标记中，因为邮箱用于识别身份，并不是机密。

e32e9ff98245.fonte: Read without echo and confirmed by the installer. Used and discarded — never written to the `.env`, to the marker or to a log, and never generated by any code: there is no path where an account is born with a password the script chose. The minimum is the DOMAIN policy, the same code registration uses; the max length here is argon2id protection, not policy.
e32e9ff98245.traducao: 无回显读取，并由安装器确认。用完即弃——绝不写入 `.env`、标记或日志，也绝不由任何代码生成：不存在账户以脚本选择的密码诞生的路径。最低要求是领域策略，与注册使用的是同一段代码；这里的最大长度是对 argon2id 的保护，而不是策略。

b6028c0aa550.fonte: Display name. Omitted: the personal workspace's name falls back to the e-mail local-part (RN-410) — nothing is invented.
b6028c0aa550.traducao: 显示名称。省略时：个人 workspace 的名称回落为邮箱的本地部分（RN-410）——不会编造任何东西。

60ab4d893529.fonte: The NORMALIZED e-mail — what was actually written, which can differ from what was typed. This is what the installer records in its marker.
60ab4d893529.traducao: 规范化后的邮箱——实际写入的内容，可能与输入的不同。安装器会把它记录在标记中。

1b8f4ac9018f.fonte: The personal workspace born in the SAME transaction (RN-410), with the account as its `owner`. Without it the install would close with a login that works and a dashboard where "New project" has nowhere to create.
1b8f4ac9018f.traducao: 在同一事务中诞生的个人 workspace（RN-410），该账户为其 `owner`。没有它，安装结束时会有一个能用的登录，而仪表盘中的“新建项目”却无处可建。

c21788334a53.fonte: The decision is the user's — either a direct click, or delegated by a policy they wrote. Invariant across the four constitutionally manual gates (RN-071).
c21788334a53.traducao: 决定权在用户——要么是直接点击，要么是委托给用户自己编写的策略。在四个按宪法必须手动的 gate 中保持不变（RN-071）。

e296c342d05f.fonte: Where the proof that the gate passed lives: `event_log` (types + payload filter), `teste` or `ci` (target path). Absent on a `planned` gate.
e296c342d05f.traducao: gate 通过的证据存放在哪里：`event_log`（类型 + 载荷过滤）、`teste` 或 `ci`（目标路径）。`planned` gate 上不存在。

14f91c24ef69.fonte: What needs to exist for the gate to open.
14f91c24ef69.traducao: gate 打开所需存在的东西。

92372a8b117f.fonte: What the gate produces when it passes.
92372a8b117f.traducao: gate 通过时产出的东西。

abc8dd3fad3b.fonte: The decision is the user's — direct on click OR delegated by a policy they wrote themselves (see RN-071).
abc8dd3fad3b.traducao: 决定权在用户——点击时直接决定，或委托给用户自己编写的策略（见 RN-071）。

80391193549e.fonte: Only ACTIVE gates. A `planned` gate describes a future role and should not appear on a screen that says what is happening right now.
80391193549e.traducao: 只有活跃的 gate。`planned` gate 描述的是未来的角色，不应出现在说明当下正在发生什么的界面上。

0f1472383ca4.fonte: What happens next. `correct` returns to dev; `run_secops` advances the gate; `done` releases it to the user; `await_user` parks the cycle until the open question is answered (RN-860); `blocked` means the correction cap ran out and only a human can unblock it.
0f1472383ca4.traducao: 接下来会发生什么。`correct` 退回给 dev；`run_secops` 推进 gate；`done` 将其交给用户；`await_user` 暂停周期直到未决问题得到回答（RN-860）；`blocked` 表示修正上限已用尽，只有人才能解除阻塞。

604a7a943439.fonte: With `await_user`: the open question the cycle waits on.
604a7a943439.traducao: 配合 `await_user`：周期正在等待的未决问题。

f5fca77e8624.fonte: Where to send the browser. The `state` is signed by HMAC with `GIT_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET` — this is what prevents the callback from being forged.
f5fca77e8624.traducao: 要把浏览器发送到哪里。`state` 用 `GIT_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET` 经 HMAC 签名——正是这一点防止回调被伪造。

ee0e113b5719.fonte: Slug of the agent that passed the baton.
ee0e113b5719.traducao: 交出接力棒的代理的 slug。

d6144008a838.fonte: Artifact that motivated the handoff (product_brief, module_map…).
d6144008a838.traducao: 引发该 handoff 的制品（product_brief、module_map……）。

69ac694d685e.fonte: This field is MUTABLE — it is the current state. Each transition also becomes an immutable `handoff.*` event in the log, which is where the history lives. `superseded` (ADR 0182, RN-635): the offer stopped being the current one — the target agent was activated by another path, or a newer offer to the same target in the project replaced it (`handoff.superseded`). Only `offered` can be accepted.
69ac694d685e.traducao: 此字段是可变的——它是当前状态。每次状态转换也会在日志中成为一个不可变的 `handoff.*` 事件，历史就存放在那里。`superseded`（ADR 0182，RN-635）：该提议不再是当前的——目标代理已通过其他路径被激活，或项目中给同一目标的更新提议取代了它（`handoff.superseded`）。只有 `offered` 可以被接受。

b1c588d3500d.fonte: Only when `status=error`, with the failure message. A healthy response has no detail at all, on purpose: liveness is not the place to expose topology.
b1c588d3500d.traducao: 仅当 `status=error` 时，附带失败消息。健康的响应刻意不带任何细节：存活检查不是暴露拓扑的地方。

3afdaf3ccba2.fonte: O publisher está no allowlist curado de fabricantes conhecidos (`domain/llm/huggingface-official-publishers.ts`). `false` é qualquer reupload de terceiro — a tela mostra o aviso de segurança quando `includeCommunity=true` trouxe este resultado.
3afdaf3ccba2.traducao: 该发布者在已知厂商的策展允许列表中（`domain/llm/huggingface-official-publishers.ts`）。`false` 表示任何第三方的重新上传——当 `includeCommunity=true` 带来此结果时，界面会显示安全警告。

7ea92a3462fc.fonte: Combined (RAG_SEARCH_WEIGHT_VECTOR*vector + RAG_SEARCH_WEIGHT_LEXICAL*lexical), already filtered by the threshold — every returned hit has passed it.
7ea92a3462fc.traducao: 组合值（RAG_SEARCH_WEIGHT_VECTOR*vector + RAG_SEARCH_WEIGHT_LEXICAL*lexical），已按阈值过滤——返回的每个命中都已通过阈值。

3b386ad7be58.fonte: Cosine similarity, 0..1. `null` when this chunk had no vector.
3b386ad7be58.traducao: 余弦相似度，0..1。当此分块没有向量时为 `null`。

3f3f6fad7f41.fonte: Normalized `ts_rank`, 0..1. `null` when the term did not match in this chunk.
3f3f6fad7f41.traducao: 规范化的 `ts_rank`，0..1。当搜索词在此分块中没有匹配时为 `null`。

c4220aac8f85.traducao: 按 `kind` 区分的联合类型：“file”（`sourcePath`/`headingPath`）或 “session”（`sessionId`/`eventId`）。见 `domain/rag/rag-citation.ts`。

c07799affbb1.fonte: Between 2 and 500 characters — same rule as the Code tab search.
c07799affbb1.traducao: 2 到 500 个字符之间——与 Code 标签页搜索的规则相同。

4fff1b7e5419.fonte: When absent, searches all four scopes (RN-219/454).
4fff1b7e5419.traducao: 缺省时搜索全部四个范围（RN-219/454）。

3538b8d81ee9.fonte: 1 to 10 — when absent, uses the cap.

03f6db6a7e46.fonte: The `rag_searches` row this search left (RN-479) — the id a vote attaches to. `null` means the telemetry row was NOT written (the insert failed), which is not the same as "no results": there is nothing to attach a vote to, and the UI needs the two apart so it does not offer a control the api will refuse.
03f6db6a7e46.traducao: 此次搜索留下的 `rag_searches` 记录（RN-479）——投票所关联的 id。`null` 表示遥测记录没有写入（插入失败），这与“没有结果”不同：没有可关联投票的对象，界面需要区分两者，以免提供一个 api 会拒绝的控件。

f6a49193e0f3.fonte: `false` when the embedding provider did not respond — the search ran with only the lexical signal (RN-233).
f6a49193e0f3.traducao: 当嵌入提供商没有响应时为 `false`——搜索只用词法信号运行（RN-233）。

ca6ea5e2da8c.fonte: Self-reported by the model, not measured.
ca6ea5e2da8c.traducao: 由模型自报，并非测量所得。

0ebcab0ee6b9.fonte: At least one, and each one has to EXIST in this session. Made-up evidence is rejected with 400 — that is what separates a hypothesis from an opinion.
0ebcab0ee6b9.traducao: 至少一个，且每一个都必须存在于本会话中。编造的证据会以 400 拒绝——这正是假设与意见的区别。

55f5493c0654.fonte: REQUIRED when `cause` indicates an abnormal termination.
55f5493c0654.traducao: 当 `cause` 表示异常终止时必需。

61ccb5ec987e.fonte: The analysis round that generated this hypothesis.
61ccb5ec987e.traducao: 生成此假设的分析轮次。

d220dec3fbf2.fonte: Which agent the hypothesis is about.
d220dec3fbf2.traducao: 该假设针对的是哪个代理。

e224dc75d833.fonte: Confidence declared by the model itself. Not a measurement, a self-report.
e224dc75d833.traducao: 由模型自己声明的置信度。不是测量，而是自报。

2aff35acdc14.fonte: Log events that support the hypothesis. This is what makes the evidence auditable instead of taken on faith.
2aff35acdc14.traducao: 支持该假设的日志事件。正是这一点让证据可审计，而不是凭信任接受。

3a4c8dbf6677.fonte: Present only on hypotheses about an abnormally terminated session.
3a4c8dbf6677.traducao: 仅出现在关于异常终止会话的假设上。

e2e24520a106.fonte: The ORIGIN of the failure. Never deduced by elimination — lesson from ADR 0020.
e2e24520a106.traducao: 失败的来源。绝不通过排除法推断——ADR 0020 的教训。

4c06a58a5edb.fonte: OCI reference with an explicit tag or digest.
4c06a58a5edb.traducao: 带有显式 tag 或 digest 的 OCI 引用。

93bc99fd4213.fonte: Id of the `open_infra_pr` `proposed_action` that opened the PR. It is what the engine knows in return — there is no separate artifact id.
93bc99fd4213.traducao: 打开该 PR 的 `open_infra_pr` `proposed_action` 的 id。这是 engine 反过来知道的东西——没有单独的制品 id。

95a9fdbd9c2d.fonte: Goes through the SAME QA and SecOps gates as dev PRs.
95a9fdbd9c2d.traducao: 经过与 dev PR 相同的 QA 和 SecOps gate。

2988459bf6fe.fonte: null when the project hasn't provisioned a repository yet. The Workflows subagent (Phase 8c) decides the CI pipeline format from this: "gitlab" generates .gitlab-ci.yml, any other value generates GitHub Actions.
2988459bf6fe.traducao: 项目尚未置备仓库时为 null。Workflows 子代理（Phase 8c）据此决定 CI 流水线格式：“gitlab” 生成 .gitlab-ci.yml，其他任何值都生成 GitHub Actions。

5f48b9159e40.fonte: The Architect-routed candidates (route_modules_to_infra, ADR 0131) — what the Infra Lead elects among when proposing container_start (ADR 0130/0133). "sem_roteamento" when the Architect has not routed anything yet.
5f48b9159e40.traducao: 由 Architect 路由的候选项（route_modules_to_infra，ADR 0131）——Infra Lead 在提议 container_start 时从中选择（ADR 0130/0133）。Architect 尚未路由任何内容时为 “sem_roteamento”。

bc693491d86d.fonte: RN-852: the CURRENT artifact.project_image decision (image, network, resources) — the FROM of the Dockerfile and the network the Infra compose respects. null when no image has been decided.
bc693491d86d.traducao: RN-852：当前的 artifact.project_image 决定（镜像、网络、资源）——Dockerfile 的 FROM 以及 Infra compose 所遵循的网络。尚未决定镜像时为 null。

2e6a7f3ecf54.fonte: The content comes from the `proposed_action`'s own payload: an infra artifact NEVER touches a worktree, same as ADRs.
2e6a7f3ecf54.traducao: 内容来自 `proposed_action` 自身的载荷：基础设施制品绝不接触 worktree，与 ADR 相同。

de7ff2ca022f.fonte: The patch `proposed_action` that produced this version, if there was one.
de7ff2ca022f.traducao: 产生此版本的补丁 `proposed_action`（如有）。

2b3f47064d44.fonte: The Psychologist's hypothesis that motivated the patch — the closed loop.
2b3f47064d44.traducao: 引发该补丁的 Psychologist 假设——闭合的循环。

13df3ae06489.fonte: Whether this is the version in effect.
13df3ae06489.traducao: 这是否是当前生效的版本。

e8ab91377c9a.fonte: Diff of this version against the previous one, computed server-side so the UI does not need its own differ. The oldest one is diffed against empty, so it shows up as all-addition.
e8ab91377c9a.traducao: 此版本与上一版本的 diff，由服务端计算，因此界面不需要自己的比较器。最旧的版本与空内容比较，所以显示为全部新增。

311878f10a4a.fonte: Nome pra você reconhecer este token depois — não é único.
311878f10a4a.traducao: 供你以后认出这个令牌的名称——不要求唯一。

a11dabd734a3.fonte: Expira em N dias. Omitido = sem expiração (revogável a qualquer hora, mas nunca expira sozinho).
a11dabd734a3.traducao: N 天后过期。省略 = 不过期（随时可撤销，但绝不会自行过期）。

77ef050aa7b7.fonte: Guarde agora — não é recuperável depois. Use em --token ou BRABO_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.
77ef050aa7b7.traducao: 现在就保存——之后无法找回。用于 --token 或 BRABO_ACCOUNT_TOKEN。

3dae3a00b619.fonte: How another module uses the item: call a function, hit a route, subscribe to an event, or build a data shape.
3dae3a00b619.traducao: 另一个模块如何使用该条目：调用函数、访问路由、订阅事件，或构建数据结构。

3c88f50638cd.fonte: How another module uses it. Up to 300 characters.
3c88f50638cd.traducao: 另一个模块如何使用它。最多 300 个字符。

001d4405596b.fonte: How many origin references the rule cites.
001d4405596b.traducao: 该规则引用了多少个来源参考。

c506c0c1cde5.fonte: Active public Ed25519 keys. Two during a rotation.
c506c0c1cde5.traducao: 活跃的 Ed25519 公钥。轮换期间有两个。

48dd0efec223.fonte: The provider can LIST its own catalog (catalog sync).
48dd0efec223.traducao: 提供商可以列出自己的目录（目录同步）。

16b214287231.traducao: 文本 → 向量（ADR 0075）。只有经过验证时才为 `true`。

e705bb58c344.fonte: The provider accepts a ROUTING PREFERENCE (`price`, `throughput`, `latency`) to pick among the upstreams serving the same model (ADR 0166). Only `true` after a smoke against the real API returned the chosen upstream — reading the docs does not count.
e705bb58c344.traducao: 提供商接受路由偏好（`price`、`throughput`、`latency`），用于在服务同一模型的多个上游之间进行选择（ADR 0166）。只有在针对真实 API 的冒烟测试返回了所选上游之后才为 `true`——阅读文档不算数。

73c8e8eeb55f.fonte: The provider accepts explicit PROMPT-CACHE breakpoints (`cache_control`) on the stable prefix of a call (RN-892). Only `true` after a smoke against the real API showed cached input tokens on a repeated call.
73c8e8eeb55f.traducao: 提供商接受在调用的稳定前缀上设置显式的提示词缓存断点（`cache_control`）（RN-892）。只有在针对真实 API 的冒烟测试显示重复调用中出现了缓存的输入 token 之后才为 `true`。

9e2d1cace77f.fonte: The provider's failure. Comes in the BODY with 200, not as an HTTP error, because the accounting in `usage` remains valid — the turn spent, even while failing.
9e2d1cace77f.traducao: 提供商的失败。以 200 在响应体中返回，而不是作为 HTTP 错误，因为 `usage` 中的计费仍然有效——即使失败，该回合也产生了花费。

e723527e14f1.fonte: The provider failure's normalized `code` (ADR 0041) — `auth`, `rate_limit`, `insufficient_credit` (HTTP 402, RN-730), `model_not_found`, `context_length`, `timeout`, `connection` or `upstream`. `null` with no error, or when the error is not the provider's (budget, missing binding). Decide by this, never by the text of `error`.
e723527e14f1.traducao: 提供商失败的规范化 `code`（ADR 0041）——`auth`、`rate_limit`、`insufficient_credit`（HTTP 402，RN-730）、`model_not_found`、`context_length`、`timeout`、`connection` 或 `upstream`。没有错误，或错误不属于提供商（预算、缺少 binding）时为 `null`。请依据它做判断，绝不依据 `error` 的文本。

729098251af8.fonte: Name of the model that generated the response (finding from problem 2) — `null` when the turn failed before resolving a model (no binding, or binding to a non-existent model).
729098251af8.traducao: 生成响应的模型名称（问题 2 的发现）——当回合在解析模型之前就失败时（没有 binding，或 binding 指向不存在的模型）为 `null`。

f79b198ccadd.fonte: Present (always `true`) only when the provider cut the response at the output cap (`finish_reason: "length"` / `stop_reason: "max_tokens"`, RN-737): the text and the `toolCalls` arguments are truncated. The engine refuses to run a truncated tool call and narrates the cut.
f79b198ccadd.traducao: 仅当提供商在输出上限处截断了响应时出现（始终为 `true`）（`finish_reason: "length"` / `stop_reason: "max_tokens"`，RN-737）：文本和 `toolCalls` 的参数都被截断。engine 拒绝执行被截断的工具调用，并叙述这一截断。

dcbac7edbc4e.fonte: The step where the Jev chose the tool (ADR 0179, RN-625). Absent when the router was not consulted (provider other than OpenRouter, fewer than two tools, workspace switch off). The engine narrates it as `tool_router.decided`.
dcbac7edbc4e.traducao: Jev 选择工具的那一步（ADR 0179，RN-625）。未咨询路由器时缺省（提供商不是 OpenRouter、工具少于两个、workspace 开关关闭）。engine 将其叙述为 `tool_router.decided`。
